item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Cauliflower and chickpea curry with jasmine rice and flatbread, topped with chopped parsley. Served with roasted almonds, fresh coriander and diced apple. (1+9+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: French ratatouille with herbes de Provence rice and a poached egg. Served with garlic bread. (1+2+10+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Crispy pakoras with rice, spiced lentil sauce and chutney. Served with chilli and fresh coriander on the side. (1+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Baked cauliflower with warm spices, coconut curry sauce, roasted cashews, fresh coriander and naan bread. (1+9+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Golden falafel with creamy hummus, warm pita bread (gluten-free option available) and a rich herb tabbouleh. Served with tzatziki, Greek salad, pickled mild Turkish chilli, feta garlic cream and chilli sauce. (1+2+6+11+15)
